server.name: Vamos
server.description: Vamos — research and write social media content: trending formats, hooks and creators on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, competitor and Meta ad research, video and comment breakdowns, and posts, scripts and captions for any platform in the workspace brand voice.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Vamos researches and writes social media content: what is working on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube (trending formats, hooks and topics, a creator's or competitor's best posts, similar creators), breakdowns of a post's hook, comments or video, Meta ads, and posts, hooks, scripts and captions in the user's brand voice.

It reads public posts and profiles by @handle or link (metrics, comments, transcripts, the video itself) and the Meta Ad Library, and knows the workspace's brand, voice, memory and saved files. The user's private analytics (retention, reach, follower growth), DMs and dashboards are outside it, as is non-social work such as code.

Send each request with chat_completion_start and poll chat_completion_poll until it is done.

- Send the user's request in their own words, as one message even when it has several parts ("find X, then write Y from it"), with anything they told you earlier that it needs: their niche, platform, offer, handles or links. Vamos plans its own research, so a plan, output spec or numbers you add yourself narrow or mislead it. If the answer misses something, follow up in the same chat.
- Keep one chat per project: continue the matching chat from list_chats, or create_chat for new work. Send the next message once the answer has arrived; one sent while a run is working starts a second run.
- When the user asks to save something to their workspace (a brand fact, a voice rule, creators to track, a routine), pass it on in their words; Vamos saves it.

tool.name: chat_completion_start
tool.title: Ask Vamos
tool.description:
Ask Vamos to research or write social media content: what is working on TikTok, Instagram or YouTube (trending formats, hooks and topics in a niche, a creator's or competitor's best posts, similar creators), a post's hook, comments or video, Meta ads, and posts, hooks, scripts or captions in the workspace's brand voice.

Returns a runId in under 2s while Vamos works: seconds for a rewrite, 2-8 minutes for research. Call chat_completion_poll with the runId until it is done; the answer is its `result`.

Credits bill when the run completes, even if you stop polling; chat_completion_cancel stops it.

content.description: The user's whole request in their own words. Vamos already has this chat's history and the workspace brand. Examples: "break down @vanessalau.co's last 30 days", "tighten hook 2, add a stronger CTA".

tool.name: chat_completion_poll
tool.title: Get the answer
tool.description:
Wait for a chat_completion_start run. The server holds each call up to 50s and returns as soon as the status changes.

`working`: call again at once, with no sleep and nothing written to the user in between. `done`: `result` is the answer; give it to the user with its links and details intact, since the links are its sources. `failed`: `error` says why. `cancelled`: stopped by chat_completion_cancel.

data.description: With include_data: row counts and file links, or the rows.

stage.description: Which half of a `working` run is in progress.

result.description: The answer. Present only when status is `done`.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vamos to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vamos to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getvamos.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Vamos MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Vamos scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Vamos's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Vamos scores 80/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 9 of 9 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vamos?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Vamos in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: How can Vamos improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: chat_completion_poll is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 73/100. Explain the meaning of this value, not just its name. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
